definitions.explanation: Physical or mental exertion for wages or production; work as an economic activity.

examples.japanese: {八時間|はちじかん}{労働|ろうどう}が{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: An eight-hour workday is the standard.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{条件|じょうけん}を{改善|かいぜん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Working conditions need to be improved.

examples.japanese: {肉体|にくたい}{労働|ろうどう}は{体|からだ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: Physical labor puts strain on the body.

notes:
USAGE: {労働|ろうどう} refers to work in an economic or social context, often emphasizing the physical or productive aspect of work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{労働|ろうどう}{者|しゃ} (worker, laborer)
・{労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい} (labor union)
・{労働|ろうどう}{条件|じょうけん} (working conditions)
・{労働|ろうどう}{時間|じかん} (working hours)
・{肉体|にくたい}{労働|ろうどう} (manual labor)
・{頭脳|ずのう}{労働|ろうどう} (mental work)

CONTRAST:
・{労働|ろうどう} - labor (economic/social concept)
・{仕事|しごと} - work, job (general term)
・{働|はたら}き - work, labor (more personal/individual)
